description: Plugins: connected services, reusable skills and MCP capabilities.
Primary model: select, configure, check and start a model profile.
Voice model: configure the separate realtime voice connection.
Notifications: configure background task completion sound.
Browser settings: configure how control of browser tabs is granted.
Open the built-in browser window. This does not sign in or change permissions.
Settings overview: guided initial setup, workspace and first result.
Vault: create or unlock encrypted storage and access recovery options.
Keys and variables: manage credentials for explicitly configured services.
MCP access: select available connected tools and their model permissions.
Mobile devices: HTTPS pairing and managing connected phones.
Execution environment: inspect and select supported runtime modes. Windows preview does not support Linux KVM or agent shell commands.
Workspace: select the folder used for tasks.
Password and locking: configure Vault and interface locking.
Backups and recovery: inspect available encrypted backup actions.
Storage locations: inspect application data directories.
Computer check: inspect local capabilities and runtime readiness.
Home: return to chats and projects.
New session: open the new-chat form; no task is submitted automatically.
Scheduled tasks: inspect and configure recurring tasks.
Code reviews: GitHub review workspace when connected.
ChatGPT workspace: open the ChatGPT interface; separate account sign-in may be needed.
OpenCode workspace: inspect the integrated OpenCode interface when supported and configured.
Notification center: view application event notifications; this differs from notification preferences.
Runtime logs: view diagnostics in the application.
Agent history: inspect historical sessions and activity.
Task plan: view the current session plan and context information.
Changes: inspect file modifications in the current session.
Files: inspect files and artifacts in the current session.
Checkpoints: inspect saved workspace states; opening does not restore or roll back anything.
Agents: inspect current session agents; opening does not launch agents.
Owner terminal: open the session terminal where supported and authorized. This does not grant shell access to the model.
Downloads: inspect browser download history.
Settings access: inspect interface locking controls.
Plugin settings: configure connected services in the settings window.
Keyboard shortcuts: view application shortcuts.
About: view the installed application version and release information.
Updates: the current interface has a placeholder button; checking or installing updates is not implemented. Do not promise an updater.
